race.comment: READY TO RUSH (8) lightly raced mare building a good winning CV. Won here two back over this trip in dominant style. Total forgive from the outside gate when she speared to the front before fading in the straight when thirteenth over 1200m at this track to Lord Remlap. Better set up today and expected to go close. BENGAL (2) returned to this class with a slashing third to Lord Remlap over 1200m here from the sticky draw. Can box seat and take holding out. OH ARTHUR (1) continues to raise the bar in the two undefeated runs this time in. Huge jump in grade when he led throughout to grip on over 1100m at Rosehill in BM78 class. Can offset the 62kg from the low gate. Sure to be competitive. BRAVE XENA (5) resumes after failing to make an impression in stakes class at her last two runs
